brand.name: FACT
brand.intro: Bring people and agents together around your work, from organizing evidence to professional analysis. Keep judgment in human hands.
brand.mission: Empower expertise with intelligence. Ground judgment in facts. Keep improving professional services.
brand.human_judgment: Intelligence contributes. People own professional judgment.
brand.fact_description: Start with real sources and evidence. Distinguish facts, inferences and assumptions.
brand.accountable_description: Clarify responsibilities for people, agents and reviewers. Keep key judgments accountable.
brand.controllable_description: Set boundaries for data, access and execution. Keep AI within its authorized scope.
brand.traceable_description: Connect sources, processing and review records so judgments can be traced.
brand.principles_title: Intelligence and expertise. A shared foundation of trust.
brand.principles_note: These principles guide ongoing design and delivery. They are not a claim that every capability is implemented or certified.
brand.fields_description: Starting with audit and forensics, with legal, consulting and tax collaboration to explore.
